svg.title: A-104 Penthouse Plan — Detached Villa
svg.text: CANTILEVER CARRIED TO THE TOP — SERPENTINE, 1.95 m AT EACH END → 1.35 m
External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
SOUTH TERRACE, WEST OF THE CORRIDOR
1. Bedrooms are numbered 1 to 11 through the house, south to
north and west before east on each floor; the ground
floor's room is the guest bedroom and carries no number.
2. Final draft — layout agreed. The two open areas are joined
outside the flat, down the west, by a corridor 2.51 m
clear against the 2.00 m asked for, pergola over its whole
length. The front door is off it.
3. 46.0 m² indoors; 15.7 m² of balcony on the cantilever,
11.5 m² of terrace by the stair, 12.2 m² north and 33.3 m²
of corridor — all four run into one another.
4. The corridor passes east of the stair: the well is 2.00 m
wide and hard against the west parapet, its half landing
1.65 m below this floor, so it stays open. Its east side
is the flat's west wall, on the spine at x 17.46 — the one
line on this side of the roof with a beam under it.
5. That leaves the flat 4.09 m clear, which will not take two
bedrooms side by side: stacking them needs 12.06 m of the
13.50 m depth and leaves 1.44 m for both terraces. The
second bedroom is what pays for the corridor.
6. The living room runs south to the building's face, so it
opens straight onto the cantilever; y 3.65 is a grid line,
so that wall sits on the columns and over the wall below.
At +16.45 the penthouse is a fourth storey for most
Final draft — layout agreed with the client; not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P18 2026-10-07 scheme A adopted: serpentine balcony on every plan; site named
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
P20 2026-10-07 internal partitions 100 mm red brick, specified by the client
P21 2026-10-07 300 mm external and party walls: brick, colour unrestricted
